description: **11. HTTP/2 Multiplexing & Keep-Alive Tuning** Enable HTTP/2 on the reverse proxy with tuned keep-alive (60s) and max concurrent streams. Eliminates head-of-line blocking and reuses TCP connections. **12. Cursor-Based Pagination** Replace `OFFSET/LIMIT` pagination with cursor-based tokens for large datasets. Deep-page offset scans degrade linearly; cursor pagination stays O(1) per page. **13. Lazy Initialization of Heavy Middleware** Defer auth validation, logging sinks, and feature-flag loading until first use. Reduces cold-start latency and prevents request blocking during eager init. **14. Circuit Breakers for External API Dependencies** Wrap third-party API calls with resilience patterns (circuit breaker + fallback to cached response). Prevents cascading failures during upstream outages. **15. Request Rate Limiting & Load Shedding** Token-bucket rate limiting at the API gateway protects against abusive traffic and DDoS, preventing CPU/memory exhaustion under sudden load. ---
